comparison.objective: Plot three geological strike/dip symbols using the right-hand rule; candidate physically tunes an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Interpreting readings and drawing oriented symbols differs from bimanual mechanical tool use, collar adjustment, force-limited locking, and impact inspection.
comparison.success_condition: Three symbols must encode the readings correctly; the record omits angular, positional, and drawing tolerances. Candidate measures physical stop performance and lock drift.
comparison.reason: This is primarily spatial interpretation and marking, not mechanical commissioning.
